### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>sigstore/sigstore (github.com/sigstore/sigstore)</summary>

### [`v1.11.1`](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/sigstore/releases/tag/v1.11.1)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/sigstore/compare/v1.11.0...v1.11.1)

#### What's Changed

v1.11.1 drops the Go version directive to a minor release, `1.27`, rather than the patch release, `1.27.0`. Dependents will need to remove the patch version `.0` from go.mod files, as `go mod tidy` will not automatically do so.

- Support ML-DSA for GCP KMS keys in [#​2395](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/sigstore/pull/2395)
- Set go directive to minor version only (go 1.27) in [#​2436](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/sigstore/pull/2436)
- Check private key size in LoadED25519phSigner in [#​2438](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/sigstore/pull/2438)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/sigstore/sigstore/compare/v1.11.0...v1.11.1>

### [`v1.11.0`](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/sigstore/releases/tag/v1.11.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/sigstore/compare/v1.10.11...v1.11.0)

#### What's Changed

v1.11.0 and v1.10.10 are identical releases tagged for the same commit. Since the minimum Go version has been bumped to 1.27.0, we are releasing this change as a minor version bump. Dependencies that do not want to update to 1.27 yet can use v1.10.11, and we'll backport any security fixes to v1.10.x for the next 6 months while Go 1.26 is still supported.

- Validate [`ed25519`](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/sigstore/commit/ed25519) public key length in verifier constructors in [#​2378](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/sigstore/pull/2378)
- Add retryable HTTP transport in [#​2396](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/sigstore/pull/2396)
- Fix Azure KMS ECDSA signature verification (r||s ordering + padding) in [#​2410](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/sigstore/pull/2410)
- Bump go to 1.27 and fix linter and api issues in [#​2415](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/sigstore/pull/2415)
- Support for ML-DSA keys in [#​2416](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/sigstore/pull/2416)
- adjust mldsa error handling in [#​2417](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/sigstore/pull/2417)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/sigstore/sigstore/compare/v1.10.9...v1.11.0>

</details>
